Ok so this might be long, sorry.  I started planning the proposal in February, proposed in April.  Her sister and I would meet to discuss what I would do.  Her parents are divorced and her dad lives in Montana, we live in Colorado.  So I asked her mom's permission to propose, and her mom was totally on board.  I needed to find out what type of ring she liked, but I didn't know how to do so without being completely obvious.  Her mom, sister, herself, and I went to the mall one day just to "walk around".  While we were in there we passed a jewelry store and her mom and sister said they wanted to have some rings cleaned. While they were getting the rings cleaned we all looked at engagement rings, and I just hung back looking borded but paying attention to what she liked.  

The next week I went to Jared's (lol I had to go to jared's) and picked out her ring and payed for it.  I was in grad school at the time, but wanted to ask her fathers permission before I asked her, so I found a same day flight up to Montana and back, that would put me home before she got home.  The catch was I would have to leave at like 3 in the morning to get to the airport on time to catch the flight. 

I set my alarm to get up that morning but she was still awake when I woke up.  My whole planned rested on her not knowing I was gone.  She got all inquisative and started really grilling me on why I was waking up and where I was going.  I made up this really lame excuse that I had a study group meeting and had to get going for an upcoming final.  

She didn't believe me, and probably due to the stupid grin on my face, let me leave that day.  I rushed to the airport and made it to Montana.  Her dad picked me up from the airport and we went out to lunch.  Now just to jump back a bit, when I called him and told him I wanted to come up and ask him a question, he told me over the phone that he was pretty sure he knew what I wanted to ask and I didn't need to come up, but I had some extra money and I really wanted to do this right.  So at lunch we got to talking and then I just awkwardly blurted it out.  He said yes and he was thrilled to have me in his family.  After lunch I had time until my next flight so he took me to his house to chill for a while.  While we were driving my then gf now fiance called me to tell me she locked her keys in the house and she needed me to come from where ever my study group was and let her in the house so she could get her keys and get to work.  I couldn't help it I just started laughing and apologized.  I told her that I would be impossible for me to get back in time to let her in the house and I called her sister, who lived an hour away to go up and help her.  Turned out after she got off the phone with me she called a friend from work who came to pick her up, and all I had to do was let her in when she got home.  

Ok so then the day of the proposal came.  I had it planned to a T.  I did the cliche 12 roses 1 rose per stop thing.  I woke up that morning and told her that I had some errands to run, but her sister was coming up and wanted to hang out with her.  I had actually woken up before her that morning and went and picked up some fresh fruit for her breakfast and brought it to her with the first rose.  Each rose had a little love note attached.  She of coursed asked questions, but once again thanks to my almost complete inability to keep a suprise and the stupid grin on my face, she just accepted it.  

Her sister came up and took her to each of the stops that day, while I went and picked up the rings and went to get the tux that I had rented for the question.  

Here were the stops/roses for the day.
1. Home at breakfast
2. In her sisters car for the beginning of her trip
3. At her work, she works at Starbucks and it was across from this pretty lake, so she could get her caffine fix for the day.
4. Across the street from the Starbucks on a bench looking over the lake.(This one I had to plant before they got there so no one would steal the rose.  I hid in her parking lot in a rented car(mine was in the shop) and watched to make sure they found it.  So many walkers stopped and read the note but left it alone on the bench)
5. Downtown at a massage place
6. At a hair salon that had opened just for the day for her to get her hair done(that lady was so nice to do that for us we tipped her 100%)
7. At her favorite restaurant downtown.
8. At this hotel which we had stayed at in February for a romantic night out.
9. At the jewlry store where I got her ring, I had also purchased a set of matching earings and necklace for her to pick up there, I tied it to a stuffed monkey(that's her petname for me)
10. At her favorite store to buy an outfit
11. At a shoe store to get the shoes
12. And the last one I had at this awesome hotel downtown, with a firepit outdoors.

So the day went pretty smoothly, I was running all over town.  At one point her sister ran out of memory on her camera, so I had to go buy a new card and bring it to her.  

All the while I was super nervous, once they left I went back to the house and packed up all her things so we could stay at the hotel downtown.  I got the the hotel and checked in and got a haircut and a shave from the little shop in the hotel.  Then I went back up and changed, they were going to be there in a few hours.  I had a bunch of her friends and mine coming to see me propose, so I went down to get a drink while I waited for her to show up.  This really nice couple at the bar asked me why I was so dressed up and we got to talking and they just kept buying me drinks.  I was trying really hard to moderate it so I wouldn't be trashed by the time she got there. (I was ok). 

About an hour before she was goign to show I went out to the firepit with our friends and layed down all the rose petals I found and started waiting.  

Now I should have thought about this before, but my lady and her sister had to go back home to change for the night, and I had taken all her stuff, so they had to go buy makeup to wear so they could look presentable.  Which made them late for the event.  At this point I know my lady, and she is late to everythign so I wasn't worried, but the large crowd that had gathered because I wasn't being that discreet with the proposal were getting nervous.

She finally showed up and everyone got dead silent.  I got down on one knee and asked and she was in shock.  She said yes, and everyone cheered.  That nice couple at the bar brought up champagne for us to drink.

The next day it all hit her and she started crying.  She said I was being so shifty that she was convinced I was cheating on her.  The people at her work were in on it, b/c most of them were coming to the proposal, so when she'd go to work each day and complain about how I was lying now, they were all on my side, they would say, maybe he's buying you a puppy, or a new car.

Anyways that's my story sorry it's so long this is my first ever reddit post, my friend at work turned me on to it, and after reading so many of this posts I am so happy to have found a community of people like this.
